thread:
anna: Quick async check — Q1 OKR milestone sweep for inference infra + Console. TL;DR: runtime-v3 canary mostly good, Dedicated autoscaler slipped, console per-route dashboards shipped but cost breakdown missing. Please reply with one-line status (shipped/slipped), owner, blocker, ETA.
mike: runtime-v3 canary — shipped to canary yesterday. p95 latency down ~12%. owner: mike. blocker: KV cache bug on ~2% of requests, investigating. ETA full rollout: EOD Fri if tests pass. PR #3421.
jess: Dedicated autoscaler — slipped. owner: jess. blocker: autoscaler is evicting GPU pods incorrectly when affinity + taints present. Need infra to reproduce test cluster. ETA +2w for fix + validation.
sudeep: I can repro locally, will provision test cluster tomorrow AM. also need GPU driver bump to 530.x in test nodes. tagging infra.
olivia: infra: can carve out a test cluster Tue 9am PT. please drop exact repro steps + minimal script here.
jess: added repro gist: https://gist.github.com/jess/autoscaler-repro (steps + logs). short command: ```kubectl apply -f repro.yaml && ./run-scale-check.sh```
mike: FYI — quantization profile we tested for llama2-q4 caused ~2% generation failures; rolled back on canary. filing issue #118. not blocking but will need a patch.
anna: Console per-route dashboards — shipped, owner: olivia. blocker: token-cost events pipeline lagging so per-route cost breakdown is stale. ETA for backfill + live fix: 3 days.
olivia: raised PR #789 for backfill job, running dry-run now. ETA Wed EOB to verify.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary rollout for runtime-v3 at 1862505320 (30% traffic).
mike: quick ask — need one more CR on #3421 from @anna, pinged reviewers.
anna: ack, I'll review today.
jess: temporary mitigation for autoscaler: pin older scaling policy for affected clusters (see #ops-runbooks). agree to short-term rollback? need sign-off.
sudeep: yes — agree. I'll coordinate the change with infra.
olivia: :thumbsup:
anna: Thanks all. Owners, please update the OKR tracker by EOD. If you need a blocker escalated to leadership, tag me. closing thread.
